outcome: Post-traumatic stress disorder following childbirth (PTSD-FC) symptoms
cohort: 794 primiparous women who gave birth to singletons
finding: While antenatal class attendance was unexpectedly associated with poorer childbirth experiences, it was also associated with lower rates of PTSD-FC intrusion symptoms.
mod_finding: This study on PTSD following childbirth examined the relationship between antenatal class attendance and childbirth experiences, including the use of forceps and emergency caesarean sections, but did not report findings specific to mode of delivery.
